headline: Houthi Fighters Launch Ground Incursions Into Saudi Arabia
summary: Houthi militants have launched multiple cross-border ground raids into Saudi Arabia, marking a major escalation following daily drone and missile attacks.
why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East directly impact regional stability and international crude oil supplies, making security developments in Saudi Arabia critical for global energy markets.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Saudi Arabia is the primary location and target of the military incursions.
